Just a Guy
Sep 5, 2019 #4

Thanks, and thanks to @rslater12 for helping investigate. It appears as if the XRP Testnet address associated with this connector (rPnLkedgftHcqWb1eJdf8vzHbu8rXtFEuE) does not have sufficient funds. If we look at your debug stack, we can see your error comes from receiving a BTP packet (you successfully sent a BTP packet on the line above):

2019-09-03T01:54:10.090Z connector:/home/dassy/.nvm/versions/node/v8.16.0/lib/node_modules/moneyd-uplink-xrp/node_modules/ilp-plugin-xrp-asym-client/index.js[parent]:trace debug received btp packet. type=TYPE_ERROR requestId=1723559554 info=

The resolution to this issue is that somebody needs to fund the xPring wallet: rPnLkedgftHcqWb1eJdf8vzHbu8rXtFEuE
